name: screenshot-to-code
setup: POETRY_CACHE_DIR="$PWD/.tools/poetry-cache" POETRY_VIRTUALENVS_CREATE=false .venv/bin/uv tool run --python 3.12 --from poetry==2.5.1 --with poetry-plugin-export==1.10.1 poetry -C "$SRC/backend" export --with dev --without-hashes -f requirements.txt -o "$(cd "$ENV" && pwd)/poetry-export.txt"
